request.description: Returns { uploadUrl, fileUrl }. PUT the raw file bytes directly to uploadUrl (with a matching Content-Type header, no auth) within 5 minutes — the presigned URL expires after that. fileUrl is the permanent CloudFront URL to store/display once the upload completes. Any authenticated user or admin token works — this endpoint isn't role-gated.

  "partnerMaximumQuantity": 100

request.description: totalPoints is the points pool (per unit) this product carries, split across buyer/upline/pool via each active PointDistribution rule's pointsPercentage. showTotalPoints/showPointsSharing control whether the buyer-facing product detail exposes totalPoints and the per-receiver points breakdown, respectively. bulkAvailable/consumerAvailable/partnerAvailable gate whether the product shows up in the reseller (GET /products?type=reseller), consumer (GET /products?type=consumer), and partner (GET /products?type=partner) listings respectively — consumerAvailable and partnerAvailable default to true when omitted, bulkAvailable defaults to false. consumerMinimumQuantity/consumerMaximumQuantity, resellerMinimumQuantity/resellerMaximumQuantity, and partnerMinimumQuantity/partnerMaximumQuantity bound how many units a buyer can hold in their cart for this product, per cart_type — enforced in CartService.addToCart. Admin is the sole product creator/owner (no merchant_id column exists anymore).

request.description: Admin-configured additional charge for a product + product type + payment option (e.g. shipping, processing fee, platform fee). calculationType PERCENTAGE/AMOUNT controls the primary charge; fixedAmount/fixedAmountBasis adds a flat top-up (e.g. "5% + 1 MYR"). calculationBasis/fixedAmountBasis (QUANTITY|PRODUCT) controls whether that part is multiplied by quantity or applied once per line. waiveAtQuantity, if set, zeroes the charge once quantity reaches that value. The backend always recalculates this at checkout — the frontend never sends amounts.

request.description: Admin-configured optional add-on for a product + product type (e.g. gift packaging). costPerUnit=true charges per unit ordered rather than once per line; applicableMinimumQuantity gates eligibility. At checkout, the buyer opts in via addOnIds on the checkout request — the backend validates eligibility and calculates the amount, the add-on is never auto-applied and never trusts a client-sent amount.

request.description: Admin-configured coupon code for a product + product type. At checkout the buyer sends this code as one entry of couponCodes (one code per product) on the checkout request; the backend verifies it belongs to a product in the cart, matches that item's product type, is active, within start_at/end_at, meets minimumQuantity, and (if usageLimit is set) hasn't been exhausted, then calculates the discount itself — the frontend never sends a discount amount. Two codes in the same checkout may not target the same product.

If multiple discounts qualify for the same item, the single largest one is applied (no stacking between automatic discounts).

request.description: Paginated overview of every user's e-wallet balance/status.
Balance + active/inactive status for one user.
Full CREDIT/DEBIT/CHECKOUT/REFUND ledger for this user's wallet, newest first.
Activates/deactivates the user's wallet for use during normal product checkout. Inactive wallets are ignored at checkout even if useWallet is requested.

Adds amount to the user's wallet balance and records a CREDIT transaction in the same DB transaction. balance_before/balance_after are computed server-side under a row lock — concurrent operations on the same wallet can't corrupt the balance.
Removes amount from the user's wallet balance and records a DEBIT transaction. Rejected with 400 if it would take the balance negative.

  "name": "Buy Product Reward",
  "description": "Points credited to a buyer for completing a purchase",
  "symbol": "PTS",
  "colour": "#28A745",
  "eventType": "BUY_PRODUCT",
  "receiverType": "BUYER",
  "pointsPercentage": 40,
  "priority": 1
}

request.description: pointsPercentage (0-100) is the share of the purchased product's total_points this receiver gets — this is what actually drives crediting now. The legacy flat `points` field is no longer used by the distribution calculation and can be omitted. Active rules for the same eventType are expected to sum to <=100%.
